title: FOUNDATIONS OF ESOL EDUCATION
description: Examines characteristics of English language learners (ELLs), key theories in language acquisition, the role of culture in language development, and instructional program models for ELLs, while considering implications for classroom instruction.
registration_restrictions: Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component. ESOL Endorsement Program
